settings.title: IR Remote workshop
settings.subtitle: Manage buttons, learn codes through ESPHome and keep a portable backup.
settings.global_subtitle: Configure ESPHome for IR learning and manage diagnostics. Dynamic IR commands are sent through the Homey Bridge selected for the device.
settings.debug_hint: Logs detailed MQTT and IR data such as request IDs, ProntoHex/raw codes, selected carrier codebook, quantization error and transmission details. Leave disabled for normal operation.
settings.ir_word_test_hint: Developer test for the Homey IR format. Sends a 1024-word test frame through the Homey Bridge selected for the remote and uses the highest word index 1023. Debug logging must be enabled.
settings.ir_word_test_success: Test frame sent: word index __index__ of __count__ words.
settings.add_remote_hint: Add remotes from Devices > Add Device > IR Remote.
settings.no_remotes: No IR remotes have been added yet.
settings.press_remote: Point the remote at the ESPHome receiver and briefly press the same button several times. Homey compares up to 5 captures and accepts the code as soon as 3 match closely enough. Learning waits up to 30 seconds.

repair.subtitle: Add, edit, learn, test or delete the buttons of this remote.
repair.no_buttons: This remote has no buttons yet.
repair.transmitter_notice: Learned ProntoHex/raw codes are mapped into a static timing codebook. This lets Homey send them dynamically through the Homey Bridge selected for this remote.
repair.backup_hint: Export and import apply only to this remote. Import replaces this remote's name and all buttons from the backup; the Homey device ID and Bridge assignment stay unchanged.
repair.select_file: Select a JSON backup file first.
repair.confirm_import: Replace the complete current configuration of this remote with the selected backup?
repair.exported: Backup for this remote was created.
repair.imported: Backup was imported into this remote.
